nodes.summary: The function $F(x) = -\log x$ is a self-concordant barrier with parameter $1$ for $[0, \infty)$, with interior $(0, \infty)$. Along a line, $DF(x)[h] = -h/x$, $D^2F(x)[h, h] = h^2/x^2$ and $D^3F(x)[h, h, h] = -2h^3/x^3$, so $|D^3F(x)[h,h,h]| = 2(D^2F(x)[h,h])^{3/2}$ and $|DF(x)[h]| = (D^2F(x)[h,h])^{1/2}$, with equality in both; $-\log x \to +\infty$ as $x \to 0^+$.
